profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Fidelity Investments | Latina in Tech
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineering graduate from the University of Texas at Dallas and an aspiring Software Engineer and Technical Project Manager. As a first-generation Latina in tech, I’m passionate about building impactful technology and growing in software development and systems design. My background includes experience in software engineering fundamentals, data structures, machine learning, and networking protocols.



Alongside my technical growth, I’ve gained hands-on leadership and project management experience as President of SHPEtinas and an active SHPE leader. I’ve coordinated large scaled events, led fundraising and sponsorship initiatives, managed cross functional teams, and created mentorship opportunities for students in STEM. These experiences taught me how to plan, execute, and deliver projects with measurable results, a skillset I’m eager to bring into my future career in tech and project management.



As a first-generation Latina in STEM, I’m committed to leveraging my skills not only to excel in software engineering but also to empower diverse communities and drive inclusive innovation.



Skills & Interests: Java, Python, software development, machine learning, project management, technical leadership, cross functional collaboration.



Let’s connect: I’m seeking opportunities to grow as a software engineer or in project management, contribute to impactful projects, and bring my passion for innovation and teamwork to the tech industry.

positions.description:

create academic sessions. Oversee promoting study days and academic activities. Responsible for reaching out to tutors and mentors. Helping members improve scores through school and peer resources.

positions.title: Director of Recruiting
positions.description: My job is to create and implement educational programs and activities that introduce new members to the organization's values, culture, and expectations. Coordinate with other members and departments to ensure that new members receive a comprehensive orientation and onboarding experience. Develop resources and materials, such as handbooks and training guides, that help new members understand their roles and responsibilities within our organization. Provide one-on-one support and guidance to new members, including answering questions and addressing concerns. Foster a welcoming and inclusive environment for new members, and ensure they feel valued and supported. Monitor new members' progress and provide feedback and encouragement as needed. Collect feedback from new members and use it to improve the onboarding and educational programs. Collaborate with the organization's leadership to ensure that new members are integrated into the community and have opportunities for growth and development. Maintain accurate records and documentation of new members' progress and activities.
